headline: Paraguay eliminates Germany in dramatic penalty shootout, advances to Round of 16
summary: Four-time world champions Germany were knocked out of the tournament after a thrilling 4-3 penalty shootout loss to Paraguay, ending their unbeaten streak in World Cup shootouts.
details: Paraguay secured a stunning 4-3 victory over four-time world champions Germany in a penalty shootout, eliminating them from the Round of 32.
The match, including 90 minutes of regular play and 30 minutes of extra time, concluded with a 1-1 draw. The initial five-shot penalty shootout also ended in a 3-3 tie.
In the sudden death round, Germany's Jonathan Tah missed his shot, while Paraguay's Jose Canale successfully converted his, securing Paraguay's spot in the Round of 16.
This victory marks Paraguay's return to the World Cup after 16 years. It also shatters Germany's impressive record, as they had never lost a World Cup penalty shootout before this match.
caption:
Four-time world champions Germany have been eliminated from the World Cup! Paraguay secured a stunning 4-3 victory in a dramatic penalty shootout.

Paraguay secured a stunning 4-3 victory over four-time world champions Germany in a penalty shootout, eliminating them from the Round of 32.

The match, including 90 minutes of regular play and 30 minutes of extra time, concluded with a 1-1 draw. The initial five-shot penalty shootout also ended in a 3-3 tie.

In the sudden death round, Germany's Jonathan Tah missed his shot, while Paraguay's Jose Canale successfully converted his, securing Paraguay's spot in the Round of 16.

This victory marks Paraguay's return to the World Cup after 16 years. It also shatters Germany's impressive record, as they had never lost a World Cup penalty shootout before this match.

headline_marked: [[Frequent power cuts grip Chattogram]] amid sweltering heat, disrupting daily life and businesses
headline: Frequent power cuts grip Chattogram amid sweltering heat, disrupting daily life and businesses
summary: Residents of Chattogram are enduring up to eight power outages daily, making life unbearable in the ongoing high temperatures and humidity. Businesses are also severely affected by the persistent disruptions.
details: Residents across Chattogram city are facing severe hardship due to frequent power outages amidst sweltering heat and high humidity. Many areas are experiencing load shedding seven to eight times daily, making life unbearable, especially for children.

The ordeal is shared by thousands in areas like Askar Dighir Par, Chawk Bazar, Panchlaish, and Lalkhan Bazar. Despite it being monsoon, temperatures remain unusually high, exacerbating the impact of the power cuts.

Yesterday, the city recorded a maximum temperature of 33 degrees Celsius with an average humidity of 69 percent. This combination of heat and lack of electricity is causing significant discomfort and distress.

According to Akbar Hossain, assistant director of PDB, the Chattogram region is receiving approximately 100 MW less than its daily demand, necessitating rotational load shedding. The city's peak demand on Sunday evening reached 1,621.40 MW but only received 1,528.90 MW.

Despite the deficit, documents obtained by The Daily Star reveal that the Chattogram region actually generates significantly more electricity than it consumes. On Sunday evening, 17 of its 28 power plants supplied nearly 3,000 MW to the national grid.

However, 11 power plants in the region were idle. Two units of the Kaptai Hydroelectric Power Plant were shut due to low water levels, while both units of the Raozan Thermal Power Plant were out of commission due to a severe fuel shortage.

Kamal Uddin, chief engineer (distribution) of PDB, Chattogram, explained that electricity generated locally goes into the national grid, with a portion then allocated back to the region. If the national grid's transmission to Chattogram falls short, load shedding becomes unavoidable.
